statements.title: BSR(m,3) = 2m for every m ≥ 2
statements.formal_part: partly: the lower bound 2m (Lemma 6, for the witness with slopes 0, …, m−1), the algebraic core of Lemma 2 and the second-variation inequality of the case e = 1 under the hypothesis L ⪰ 0; outside the formal part: the passage from a representation to the three summands x₀ ⊗ y_j in adapted coordinates and the deduction of L ⪰ 0, Proposition 3, Lemma 5, the case e ≥ 2 and the assembly of the upper bound

fidelity.note: La cota inferior \(2m\) está formalizada, pero para anunciar todo el caso \(e=1\) falta pasar de la representación original a los tres sumandos \(x_0\otimes y_j\) en coordenadas adaptadas y deducir para ella la hipótesis \(L\succeq0\) de `width_three_trace`.

statements.title: an integer point where the sum-of-2m-squares map is a submersion
statements.formal_part: the linear algebra: a Hankel multiplier vanishing on ker[I P Q] is zero (regular_point_hankel); the duality from there to «dΦ onto» is on paper

fidelity.note: Para cada \(m\ge2\), `regular_point_hankel` expresa que \(\ker[I\ P\ Q]\subseteq\ker H\) obliga a anular todas las entradas de \(H\) en los índices del artículo, con el paso por dualidad expresamente fuera de la cobertura.

statements.title: a boundary point carries an indefinite Hankel multiplier with first and second order conditions
at such a point: independent summands, rank at most m, no simple tensor in the image
a multiplier without simple tensors has rank above its support
an explicit form that needs 2m squares
statements.formal_part: the witness with slopes 0, …, m−1 (F_wit): its 2m squares and the lower bound 2m; the paper’s F_m uses slopes 1, …, m, and the change y₂ ↦ y₂ − y₁ that carries one to the other (with the conservation of the SOS length) is not formalized

fidelity.note: `F_wit` usa pendientes \(0,\ldots,m-1\) y el artículo usa \(1,\ldots,m\), por lo que para cubrir el testigo enunciado falta formalizar, tras reindexar las filas, el cambio invertible \(y_2\mapsto y_2-y_1\) y la conservación de la longitud SOS.

statements.title: width four: BSR(m,4) ≤ 3m, and 11 ≤ BSR(4,4) ≤ 12
statements.formal_part: the implication only: Theorem 1 enters as a hypothesis (bsr_width_four, bsr_upper_three), and Theorem 1 is itself only partly formalized; the comparison identity is fully formalized

fidelity.note: `bsr_width_four` deduce \(\mathrm{BSR}(m,4)\le3m\) de la cota explícita en anchura tres, y `bssv_identity` prueba en \(\mathbb Z\) la identidad exacta usada en las dos comparaciones.
